concerns.text: The plan applies permutation importance (Section 5.3) to the structural descriptors of a graph‑based GNN. Permutation importance assumes independent, tabular input features; permuting node or edge attributes in a graph typically destroys relational information and yields importance scores that are not meaningful for message‑passing models. This methodological mismatch may produce misleading “significant” descriptors and jeopardizes SC‑005’s claim of identifying truly influential structural features.
